Subject: Post-call exec recap: Atlas Insights / Redwood Inference

Hi Daniel / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick executive recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps. I captured the business outcomes, risks, and procurement path discussed.

Key pain points / triggers
- High per-token costs and unpredictable latency on peak workloads (customer-facing chat).
- Need for guaranteed latency SLOs for high-traffic campaigns (sub-200ms targets for 95th pct for short prompts).
- Data residency and auditability concerns (EU and US workloads; want customer-owned KMS).

Goals / desired outcomes
- Predictable runtime economics (forecastable monthly spend for pilot + scale).
- SLA-backed latency and uptime for the initial production traffic (+ escalation path).
- Private deployment option (VPC) for sensitive workloads within Q4 pilot.

Procurement & decision path
- Priya (CPo) is the exec sponsor — driving business outcomes and vendor selection.
- VP Eng (Vivek?) will validate technical fit; procurement@atlasinsights.com will handle contract/legal.
- Target: pilot approval by end of September; production decision by end of November.

Risks / escalation items called out
- SOC 2 / security attestation and penetration test evidence required for legal review.
- KMS integration and confirmation of key management options for private deployment.
- Cost model needs to be clear for dedicated vs hosted to compare TCO.

What Redwood will deliver next (by Fri Aug 6)
1) Draft SLA & high-level SOW (attached: Atlas_Deployment_SLA_Draft.pdf, SOW-outline.docx).
2) Short exec slide (1–2 pages) summarizing business outcomes + recommended pilot scope.
3) Cost comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated (top-line estimate + assumptions).
4) Security packet with SOC 2 summary and next steps to provide evidence to procurement.

Proposed next steps
- Schedule 30–45m executive alignment call wk of Aug 10 (Priya + VP Eng + Marissa/Eng lead).
- Loop procurement: procurement@atlasinsights.com to receive legal & SOC artifacts once SOW ready.

If this looks right I’ll: 1) send the SLA/SOW drafts to procurement and your team, 2) prep the cost slide, and 3) schedule the exec call.

Thanks — appreciate the clear context today.

Best,
